newsitem.title: USA: Ramada to test Casdim IOD System.
newsitem.headline: Ramada to test Casdim IOD System.

text.p: Casdim International Systems Inc said Wednesday Ramada Franchise Systems Inc will begin alpha and beta test of Casdim's integrated IOD -- Information-On-Demand -- System.

The system incorporates interactive TV, Internet, video-on-demand, E-Mail, and a clubmember facility using an integrated wide area network to link video and data servers via satellites and/or cable TV systems.

Casdim said the parties have agreed to enter into an agreement for full system implementation of the IOD System which would call for the HFS Inc subsidiary to recommend the system to franchisees upon the successful completion of the alpha and beta test at certain Ramada Inn locations.
The testing of the IOD System is scheduled to be completed in March 1998, Casdim said.
